records.brief: A distinctive editorial copy-adaptation emblem: TWO large sculpted quotation-mark forms, one deep magenta and one soft blush, face one another around a single broad lavender fountain-pen nib. The pen nib bridges the two voices, showing a message being carefully rewritten for a different audience and cultural tone. Integrate the forms into one confident balanced silhouette with generous negative space. The quote forms should have a graceful calligraphic curvature without forming Arabic letters. Magenta #782859, blush #F9DAE0, lavender #D6B0FC, tiny warm-ivory nib slit. No megaphone, flower, book stack, document checklist, chat bubble, alphabetic text, flags or approval marks. Broad minimal surfaces; readable at48px.

records.concept: Mediation between parties in a tenancy dispute
records.brief: A sophisticated tenancy-dispute mediation emblem: two simplified clearly recognizable hands, one muted rose and one pale ivory-lavender, meet in a restrained handshake directly beneath ONE strong dark-plum peaked HOUSE ROOF. The handshake forms the foundation of the home silhouette. Clear property + two parties + mediation, not real-estate sales, court authority or generic security. Make it an elegant compact brand sculpture, with minimal anatomical detail and no sleeves beyond two broad cuffs. Plum #3C283B, muted rose #BE8E9C, pale lavender-ivory #E3D7E9. No gavel, justice scales, key, magnifier, document page, seal, checkmark or text. Two main ideas only: home and agreement between parties.
